fan_ballot_close.note: NBA ballot release of Nov 18, 2005: 'The 2006 NBA All-Star Balloting program continues through Jan. 22, 2006'. A search summary gave January 14 for text-message voting only; the program close is used

starters_announced.note: the release scheduled 'the unveiling of the All-Star starters Thursday Feb. 2 prior to a TNT doubleheader'; the Suns' starters release is dated 060202 and reports of Feb 2-3, 2006 agree

coach_record_through.note: no 2006 source for the cutoff was found; derived from the rule's pattern, the Sunday two weeks before the game (2004: February 1 for February 15; 2005: February 6 for February 20)

reserves_announced.note: the Nov 18, 2005 release scheduled the head coaches' reserves for 'Thursday Feb. 9 on NBA TV'; the Pistons' reserves release is dated 060209

rookie_challenge_announced.note: from a search summary of the AP story 'Bogut, Howard lead Rookie Challenge roster' (ESPN id 2315429); the story itself was not loaded

replacements_named.note: the commissioner names injury replacements before the weekend; the simulation names them on the Friday the weekend opens, from closed results through the day before

electorates.reserves: the conference's head coaches, never their own players
electorates.rookie_challenge: the NBA's assistant coaches, one ballot per club staff

previous_game_coaches.note: the Riley Rule: no coach coaches two All-Star Games in a row

fan_ballot_open.note: NBA ballot release (team versions dated Nov 18, 2005): 'All-Star Balloting begins today'. 120 players on the ballot (per conference 24 G, 24 F, 12 C) chosen by a five-member media panel; voting in arenas, NBA.com in 19 languages, about 130 Loews theaters, T-Mobile t-zones and wap.nba.com.

fan_ballot_close.note: 'continues through Jan. 22, 2006'. A search summary mentioned January 14 for text-message voting; not confirmed.

starters_announced.note: Scheduled for Thursday Feb. 2 in the ballot release; starters reported on Feb 2, 2006.

starter_shape_per_conference.note: 'Voters select two guards, two forwards and one center from each conference.'

value.voters: the 30 NBA head coaches, each voting within own conference

reserves.note: The date and the head coaches' vote come from the ballot release (announced 'Thursday Feb. 9 on NBA TV'). The 2-2-1-2 shape, the 12-man roster and the own-player bar are sourced for 2005 and carried forward: no 2006 text stating them was loaded, and no change was reported.

injury_replacement.note: The 2006 game article records an injury replacement named by the Commissioner and a separate replacement starter; that the coach chose the starter is not stated (that half unverified).

value.rule: head coach of the team with the best winning percentage in each conference through games of the Sunday two weeks before the game (2006-02-05, derived)
value.repeat_restriction: 'Riley Rule': a coach may not coach consecutive All-Star Games; the next-best record coaches instead

coaches_rule.note: The 2006 article confirms the Riley Rule applied that season ('league rules prohibit a coach from coaching in consecutive All-Star Games'). The cutoff date is derived, not sourced.

value.name: T-Mobile Rookie Challenge
value.format: Rookies vs Sophomores (7th year of this format)
value.selected_by: the NBA's assistant coaches, each club's staff submitting one ballot
value.team_coaches: lead assistants from the 2006 All-Star Game coaching staffs
value.all_star_rule: a rookie or second-year player selected to the All-Star Game also plays in the Rookie Challenge
value.game_rules: two 20-minute halves; one full and one 20-second timeout per team per half; 2-minute overtime; clock stops after made field goals in the last minute of each half

rookie_challenge.note: Release: 'lead a list of 19 players selected ... The participants in the Rookie Challenge were selected by the NBA's assistant coaches, with each team submitting one ballot.' The published list carried a tenth second-year player marked as unable to play; whether the intended shape was 9 per team plus an injury spare is unverified, so roster_size_per_team 9 is unverified for this season.

rookie_challenge_rosters_announced.note: Search summary of the AP roster story; article text not retrievable.

saturday_contests.note: Participant selection (league invitation) and announcement dates not researched; event order unverified.
